name: Perth Airport

curfew.v: no curfew (no restrictions on night movements) at Perth Airport, per Airservices
curfew.quote: Why isn't there a curfew (restrictions on night movements) at Perth Airport?

slots.v: every flight needs an IATA slot from the Capacity Optimisation Group (COG), under AIP ENR 1.9
slots.quote: All flights operating into and out of Perth must obtain an IATA slot from the Capacity Optimisation Group (COG) in accordance with AIP ENR 1.9.

handling.v: GA and itinerant operators must appoint a ground handling agent 48 hours before operating; FBOs: Revesco Aviation (FBO and VIP lounge 24 hours, customs/quarantine with prior notice) and Airflite (private aircraft, 24 hours)
handling.quote: GA and itinerant operators must appoint a ground handling agent 48HR prior to OPR at Perth. ... Revesco Aviation: FBO services and VIP lounge H24. Civil and MIL ACFT, customs/AQIS with PN

fuel.v: Jet A-1 24 hours from Air BP (also F34, Avgas); Viva Energy Aviation Jet A-1 04:00-01:00 local daily
fuel.quote: AIR BP: H24 ... JET A1, F34, AVGAS. ... Viva Energy Aviation: 0400-0100 Local DLY. ... JET A1.

max_aircraft.v: the GA taxilane is for aircraft of 19,000 kg and 24 m wingspan and below; all apron operations follow the operator's parking plans
max_aircraft.quote: a. ACFT 19,000KG/24M MAX wingspan and BLW (i) GA Taxilane. ... All OPS on Perth Airport APN areas must be in accordance with relevant ACFT PRKG plans.

noise.v: noise abatement procedures apply (see AIP DAP)
noise.quote: Noise Abatement Procedures (NAP) apply. Refer AIP DAP.

permits.v: aircraft must enter or leave Australia at a designated international airport unless permission was given first; non-scheduled international flights must also contact the Department of Infrastructure (DITRDCA) before the flight
permits.quote: All Aircraft must enter or depart Australia at an airport that is designated as an international airport

missing: customs (ERSA gives customs/quarantine via the FBO 'with PN' but no hours)
notes: Read: RDS YPPH effective 09 Jul 2026 (runway 03/21 TORA 3444 m, 06/24 TORA 2163 m) and DAP aerodrome chart PPHAD01-186 (labels '3444 x 45' and '2163 x 45'). The ERSA facilities page could not be opened: https://www.airservicesaustralia.com/aip/pending/ersa/FAC_YPPH_09JUL2026.pdf (blocked) and FAC_YPPH_27NOV2025.pdf (site error), so customs, fuel, slots, parking and handling are not verified. The no-curfew fact comes from an Airservices Engage Q&A heading on the Perth new runway project (the answer says curfews are set by the Department of Infrastructure); the Commonwealth curfew page lists only Sydney, Adelaide, Gold Coast and Essendon Fields. Western Australia has no daylight time (UTC+8). 1 Nov 2026: opened ERSA FAC YPPH 09 Jul 2026 (newest found; earlier FAC 19 Mar 2026 also listed). Added slots (COG), handling (agent needed 48 h ahead; Revesco and Airflite), fuel, GA taxilane limit and noise; ERSA lines joined with '...' in quotes. Operator per ERSA: Perth Airport Pty Ltd. The ERSA states no aerodrome hours and no customs hours. Added the ABF permits rule (page updated 20 Oct 2026). GA taxilane wording is a restriction-list line; read as a limit.
